title: Nuxt.js Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the Nuxt.js course.

entries.name: Show the current page
entries.summary: NuxtPage is the place where Nuxt displays the page chosen by the address.

entries.name: Add a file route
entries.summary: A Vue file in pages becomes a route. index.vue is the home page, while books.vue makes /books.

entries.name: Navigate with NuxtLink
entries.summary: NuxtLink provides a normal link meaning while letting Nuxt handle local route navigation.

entries.name: Share a layout
entries.summary: A layout wraps pages with shared content.

entries.name: Reuse a component
entries.summary: Nuxt can auto-import components from its components folder.

entries.name: Set the page title
entries.summary: useSeoMeta describes title and description values for a page.

entries.name: Share state with a key
entries.summary: useState creates state that Nuxt can share safely within one app visit.

entries.name: Load a local JSON file
entries.summary: useFetch can load data and give the page loading and error state.

entries.name: Read a route value
entries.summary: A bracketed page file captures part of an address.

entries.name: Run browser-only work after mount
entries.summary: Some APIs exist only in the browser. onMounted runs after the component is mounted there, so it can safely read browser-only objects.

entries.name: Keep a public setting public
entries.summary: Runtime config separates public settings from server-only settings.

entries.name: Generate static pages
entries.summary: Nuxt can build a site as static files. List dynamic routes that cannot be found by following ordinary page links.
